actions.description: Obtain physical marking/package/orderable identity and match package-specific pinout; resolve auxiliary pin requirements before assigning footprints.
Resolve exact programmer and obtain voltage-under-load and timing evidence; no clock limit can currently be assigned.
Select exact TXU0304 package, footprint, availability and assembly constraints; verify logical mapping against its pin table.

Specify local 1.8 V rail with tolerance/transients in DUT operating range, current budget, decoupling, protection, ground return and sequencing. Design OE default low and verify disabled/unpowered behavior and DUT safe biasing.

Obtain complete VIH/VIL/VOH/VOL limits at actual supplies/load and budget outbound CLK/data/CS and return MISO delays, skew, setup/hold, interconnect and host sampling. Choose SPI mode and clock only after margins are demonstrated.
Create schematic and PCB using resolved packages and supply; complete ERC/DRC and review mapping, auxiliary pins, OE and sequencing.

Prepare separately authorized validation with power initially off: identity/continuity review followed, only after applicable gates, by rail, OE, levels-under-load and timing measurements. Record actual evidence; this plan authorizes no fabrication or power-on.

architecture_candidates.rationale: At nominal VCC=1.8 V, absolute pin maximum is 2.2 V; even at VCC=1.95 V it is 2.35 V. Declared 3.3 V host drive exceeds both. Absolute maxima are not operating targets. 3.3 V DUT supply also exceeds 1.95 V.

Both nominal rails fall within declared translator ranges; fixed 3+1 topology matches standard SPI. Logical signal mapping only, no package pin numbers. Application example is not component specification or validation.

Rails are in range, but each two-channel group shares direction: available static partitions are 4+0, 2+2, or 0+4, not required 3+1. Rejection applies to single-device all-four-signal mapping, not all possible multi-device alternatives.

assessment.summary: Declared page-addressed claims support a conditional TXU0304 family architecture. No conflicting supplied claims identified. Hashes identify document captures only; no physical identity or implementation is proven. Full machine plan unsupported by current component and implementation evidence.

decisions.description: Advance TXU0304 only as a family candidate; preserve default power off and all six supplied blockers.
Plan OE low for disabled outputs; implement and verify bias, reference domain, sequencing, and unpowered behavior before any enable. High impedance does not establish safe DUT input states.
